claims.claim: Whirling Death sends axes across the map, dealing physical damage outward and again on their return; hitting a champion triggers their return, and Draven can recall them early.

row.answer: Whirling Death sends axes across the map, dealing physical damage outward and again on their return; hitting a champion triggers their return, and Draven can recall them early. Damage decreases as enemies are hit and resets when the axes reverse. Champions damaged to or below a health threshold equal to his Adoration stacks are executed.
row.counterplay: Dodge the outgoing axes and move clear of their return path, especially when low on health.
